name: toastmaster-timer
description: Monorepo: Zoom app (apps/zoom-app) and marketing + web app (apps/web)

scripts.build: npm run sitemap && npm run build:web && npm run build --prefix apps/zoom-app && npm run combine:dist
scripts.combine:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/zoom && cp -r apps/web/dist/. dist/ && cp -r apps/zoom-app/dist/. dist/zoom/
scripts.cf:deploy:dev: VITE_ZOOM_OAUTH_REDIRECT='https://zoom.us/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=kgpoX2A6TY2BvdctzK9iw&redirect_uri=https://www.timer-dev.simple-tech.app/oauth/redirect' npm run build && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.dev:tabletopics: npm run build:tabletopics && wrangler dev -c apps/table-topics/wrangler.jsonc --port 8789
scripts.cf:deploy:tabletopics:dev: SITE_ORIGIN=https://www.tabletopics-dev.toastmusters.com npm run build:tabletopics && wrangler deploy -c apps/table-topics/wrangler.jsonc --env dev
scripts.cf:deploy:tabletopics:prod: npm run build:tabletopics && wrangler deploy -c apps/table-topics/wrangler.jsonc
